summary.text: Kerry Forestal is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 31 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has been Marion County Sheriff since 2019, and his term ends December 31, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Kerry Forestal won the Marion County Sheriff's race in November 2018, defeating Republican Brian Durham, and was re-elected in November 2022 over Randall Swindle.
In the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary for Senate District 31 he defeated Catherine Torzewski, Lasima Packett and Andrew Dezelan.
